messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — we’re flipping the new estimator A/B tomorrow 10am PT. Need final FAQ microcopy + routing for webinar opt-ins. Can we lock this down today?
Jorge: Looks good. Quick Q on tier names: I moved 'Committed' -> 'Reserved' in the copy. Reaction? :thinking_face:
Anika: prefer 'Committed' — users ask for commitment language in sales convos. 'Reserved' sounds too infra-y.
Lee: +1 to Anika. Also for the calc opt-in checkbox copy: 'Notify me about benchmark webinars and product updates' feels long. Suggest 'Join benchmark webinar invites'.
Maya: Nice — condensed copy works. Final FAQ item to add: "How do I reserve capacity vs pay-as-you-go?" short answer pointing to plan matrix and link.
Jorge: Routing note: if user checks opt-in and selects >50k tokens/month estimate, route to AE webhook. Otherwise route to nurture list. Proposed rule: `if (estimateTokens > 50000 && optIn) -> /webhooks/ae-leads`
Anika: Can we also tag leads from EU region with `eu-compliance` so sales prep notes include region?
Lee: Yep — webhook supports `tags: [eu-compliance]` via payload. I'll add that.
cs-bot: Deploy scheduled: pricing-estimator-v2 -> staging at 09:30 PT, prod roll at 10:00 PT if smoke tests pass.
Maya: Perfect. Last ask — webinar CTA after calc should show 3 dates (Mon/Tue/Thu) and a light registration modal, not a full page redirect. Can design deliver that by EOD?
Lee: I can do the modal. Will push a tiny UI change and copy updates.
Jorge: I'll update FAQ microcopy and push to content repo. PR incoming.
Anika: I'll confirm AE routing docs and sample payloads for Sales.
Maya: Thanks team — please react when your tasks are done :thumbsup:
